payload.summary: Sheets do not return focus to their trigger on two of three surfaces
payload.detail: Measured at +100/400/1000/2500ms after Escape. /documents/search Filter sheet leaves focus on body though the trigger is still in the DOM. /calculators/search PHQ-9 drops ?calculator=phq9 on close, the list re-renders and the trigger node is destroyed, so restore targets a detached node. The document-actions sheet restores correctly, so ui/sheet.tsx:43-46,108-110,181 is sound - these are call-site failures. After closing PHQ-9, reaching GAD-7 takes ~20 Tab presses from the top. WCAG F85 against SC 2.4.3.
